title: Fix Animation Curve Values with Metadata Curves in Unreal Engine
description:
Animation curve values get distorted by the blend in and blend out times of a montage. In this short tutorial I show how to keep the exact values until the montage ends using Metadata Curves in Unreal Engine.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:08 The problem: montage blending affects curve values
1:23 The fix: metadata curves
1:45 Adding a metadata curve to the animation
2:30 Blueprint setup: dividing by the metadata curve
3:47 Result: filtered curve values
4:11 When to use it: additive corrections and IK
